confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Milan price levels, not live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by district, season and booking lead time. July is peak season, so accommodation values assume summer demand. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer and aperitivo price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation was taken from RBA-domain search results and was not verified by opening the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on northern Italian and major European city price levels (for example Turin and Bologna, adjusted upward for Milan's higher hotel and dining costs), cross-checked against central Florence and Rome for tourist-facing hotel and hostel prices.
